{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling the thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders, as they should not count toward revenue
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = sales_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Find the channel with the highest revenue
max_revenue_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue'].idxmax()]

# Output the result
channel_revenue, max_revenue_channel"}
